sec.keysDesc: One chip everywhere: in prose, in tooltips and inside buttons. Mod is ⌘ on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere.
sec.linksDesc: A link that goes somewhere is blue, at rest and on hover, underlined on hover: running text, page links, View all and breadcrumbs alike. A light action is a text button: dark, semibold, over a grey underline.
sec.factsDesc: Two columns filled top-down, 120 px labels, ink values. A value that opens a page has a ›; hosts copy on hover; ids are masked. One column below 560 px.
facts.notesValue: A wide fact spans both columns under the grid.
sec.bandsDesc: One sentence about the whole page (40 px) or the whole table (36 px), one or two actions. Neutral for information, tinted only for warning and danger. Never blue.
band.recover: A reservation of AX41 was sent and its outcome is unknown.
band.danger: Your account is suspended. Running computers keep running; nothing new can start.
band.table: One source didn't answer. Showing what we read at 12:03.
band.note: Update this computer to change scripts here.
band.held: A snapshot named nightly may already have been taken.
notice.calm: Showing 8 of 33 computers. Open the others from Computers.
notice.warn: Review a skill before you install it: it runs with your agent's access.
notice.blockOne: Add funds before your Pro plan renews on Dec 1.
sec.firstUseDesc: Never made one: teach in one sentence, one primary action, a Guide link.
recipe.firstBody: A computer is a private machine in the cloud you can open from any browser.
sec.noMatchDesc: Data exists but the filters hide it: Clear filters, nothing else.
sec.noAccessDesc: This login can't see it. One way out, given by the page.
sec.offlineDesc: Nothing read yet and no connection. Retries on its own when the connection returns.
sec.spinnerDesc: Word-sized waits only: three pulsing dots, the same as a busy button; the Hoody mark, its parts lighting in turn, for a row that waits (with the page's line). Areas load with skeletons.
spinner.label: Checking the key
sec.disclosureDesc: A titled fold: a title, one line on what is inside, a chevron. Closed by default.
disc.title: More options
disc.openDesc: The raw request this gate is about
disc.body: The folded content sits here, indented under the title.
sec.statsDesc: 56 px above a table: caps label, ink number, muted caption, hairlines. A dot only when the stat is a status. Hidden below 600 px.
sec.tagsDesc: A tag labels a row and never changes on its own; a live state is a status pill. A monogram stands in for a provider logo. A list row is one button: a mark in a fixed box, the name as written, muted facts at the end, one hover and focus fill (the model chooser's provider lists).
steps.label: Your device
steps.step.mac: Open Terminal and run the line below.
steps.step.windows: Open PowerShell and run the line below.
steps.step.linux: Open a terminal and run the line below.
steps.step.phone: Phones use the Hoody app instead of the CLI.
ex.label: Language
sec.codeDesc: One block per door: captioned lines, Copy on each line on hover or focus, Copy all in the header. A missing fact is a token and its line can't be copied. Steps per system and the example picker choose which block shows; this browser starts on {{system}}.
code.title: Connect with the CLI
sec.compactDesc: For widgets and small regions: one line and one action, at a 32 px row height.
empty.title: Your computers live here
empty.body: A computer runs your apps, agents and Bots. The first one is free.
emptyTags.title: Nothing connected yet
error.title: Couldn't read your computers
error.body: The Hub couldn't reach the server. Try again in a moment.
sec.skeletonDesc: Shown after 150 ms, blocks at 40-70 % of their column, a slow sweep (none with reduced motion).
sec.toastsDesc: Only when the result has no place on screen. Errors and unknown outcomes stay until closed.
toast.errorBody: The computer didn't answer in time.
toast.unknownBody: Check the program list before you start it again.
sec.segmentedDesc: Separate options in one framed tray in the field look; the current one has its own framed thumb. 40 px at every size, as a field; 44 on touch. The first one keeps its choice in the URL.
sec.tabsDesc: 40 px, underline style, the open tab in the URL. On a narrow container the bar scrolls sideways with faded edges.
tabs.label: Computer
tabs.five: Five tabs, the first open: the far edge fades, so more is there. Labels never cut.
tabs.editable: Editable (Board): double-click or F2 renames; drag, Alt+Shift+arrows or the ⋯ menu moves; right-click opens a tab's menu. The second has no ⋯ button: a tab's menu opens on the tab, by right-click, Shift+F10 or the menu key, and drops from it; the page's own menu, before the tabs, renames the open tab in place, and New view sits right after the last tab.
sideTabs.label: Ways in
sec.qrDesc: Secret addresses stay blurred until Show; Copy and Open work without it. One QR surface at a time; it is wiped on close, route change or page hide.
qr.terminalWarn: Anyone with this address can use your terminal.
w.logsChart: Failed requests per hour, last 24 hours
sec.contextDesc: Where you are on one line. The realm truncates first, the computer last.
parts.linkLabel: A page this load hides keeps its label
qr.rowImage: An image the server made (2FA set-up)
qr.imageAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
